Repoussez les bêtes affamées qui barrent: Drive back the starving beasts blocking the first pass.
Dispersez les éclaireurs du Corbeau avan: Scatter the Raven scouts before they raise the alarm.
Ouvrez la route des mines tenue par la p: Open the mine road held by the Raven patrol.
Venez à bout de l’escorte du Corbeau et: Overcome the Raven escort and take the convoy’s ore.
Abattez la bête rendue folle près des ga: Bring down the beast driven mad near the galleries.
Chassez le Corbeau des galeries sacrées: Drive the Raven from the sacred galleries and return them to the Bear.
Chassez le Corbeau et prenez le filon so: Drive out the Raven and take the dark vein for the clan.
Frayez-vous un passage parmi les créatur: Cut a path through the corrupted creatures of the galleries.
Traquez le Maître Espion du Corbeau avan: Hunt down the Raven Spymaster before he leaves the mountain.
Affrontez Borin et ses guerriers pour le: Face Borin and his warriors for the Seal of the Bear.
Affrontez le gardien pour ouvrir son cof: Face the guardian to open the chest.
Les Montagnes de la Résilience. Le Sceau: The Mountains of Resilience. The Seal of the Lion sits heavy in our coffer, and yet no one here is waiting for us.
Le Clan de l’Ours garde ces pentes depui: The Bear Clan has guarded these slopes for longer than our chronicles. It does not judge a stranger by a Seal, but by what that stranger does with its mountain.
Alors montrons-lui ce que nous valons, e: Then let us show it what we are worth, and see what its mountain can give us in return.
Quelqu’un nous attend sous les sapins, à: Someone’s waiting for us under the firs, off the path. Black feathers on the shoulder, hands in plain sight. He wants to be seen.
Pas d’épée, pas de piège. Le Corbeau sai: No sword, no trap. The Raven knows the Bear is sending you. It also knows that a landless clan needs gold more than honour.
Prenez cette bourse. Montez, regardez ai: Take this purse. Climb, look away when our carts go by, and come back down with your Seal. No one will have to bleed.
Personne ne saura qui a regardé ailleurs: No one will know who looked away, and the purse is heavy. I am not saying we should accept. I am only saying that the Bear’s honour will not feed us at the next pass.
Un clan qui paie pour qu’on détourne les: A clan that pays others to look away is digging up something it does not want seen. Let us remember why Borin received us.
Refuse the gold and warn the Bear.
Borin saura ce que le Corbeau a tenté: Borin will know what the Raven tried
Take the purse and look away.
Une promesse faite au Corbeau: A promise made to the Raven
Comme vous voudrez. Le Corbeau se souvie: As you wish. The Raven also remembers the doors closed to it.
Je file prévenir la patrouille de l’Ours: I’ll run and warn the Bear patrol. They’ll know a Raven messenger is prowling their pass.
Sage décision. Quand vous verrez nos cha: A wise decision. When you see our carts, remember that you did not see them.
Écoutez… Des coups, sous les pierres. Qu: Listen… Knocking, under the stones. Someone is striking on the other side of the rockfall.
Nous sommes quatre ! La galerie s’est ef: There are four of us! The gallery collapsed when the Raven’s charges went off. We’re running out of air!
Dégager ces pierres nous coûtera la jour: Clearing these stones will cost us the day, and the Raven won’t wait for us. Their sacks of ore are right there, off to the side. Under the stones, they’re no use to anyone.
Ce sont les mineurs de l’Ours. Borin nou: These are the Bear’s miners. Borin entrusted his mountain to us; his people are part of it.
Dégager les mineurs, quel qu’en soit le: Dig the miners out, however long it takes.
Take their ore and press on.
Vous êtes venus pour nous ? Pour des min: You came for us? For miners? Borin will know what you did, I promise you.
Nous les entendrons frapper encore longt: We will hear them knocking for a long time yet, Maelor. Long after we have counted this ore.
Des fils tendus en travers du sentier, e: Wires strung across the path, and powder in skins under the stones. They’re Raven traps, laid for the Bear patrols.
Cette poudre vaut de l’or dans une forge: This powder is worth gold in a forge, and more in a fight. The Raven paid for it; we could at least take it off their hands.
Si nous la prenons sans rien dire, les p: If we take it without a word, the next traps will be laid elsewhere, and the Bear will know nothing of it.
Que fait-on de ces pièges ?: What do we do with these traps?
Désarmer les pièges et les signaler aux: Disarm the traps and report them to the patrols.
Keep the powder for the company.
Les pièges suivants resteront secrets: The next traps will stay secret
Je laisse notre marque sur chaque pierre: I’m leaving our mark on every trapped stone. The patrols will know it.
Je prends la poudre. Si l’Ours trouve d’: I’ll take the powder. If the Bear finds more traps higher up, it won’t know we knew.
Des murs de pierre et des feux gardés. P: Stone walls and guarded fires. For the first time since the pass, no one is watching us from the rocks.
Les guerriers de l’Ours ne nous quittent: The Bear warriors never take their eyes off us. A Seal of the Lion weighs little at this altitude.
Ils apprendront à nous connaître par ce: They will come to know us by what we do in their mines. Let us rest, and prepare for what comes next.
Cette galerie s’est effondrée il y a lon: This gallery caved in long ago. Under the dust, a carved object: a rearing bear, cut from dark stone and set with a red gem.
C’est un objet sacré du clan. Il apparte: It is a sacred object of the clan. It belonged to a Bear shrine; someone hid it here, perhaps to protect it.
Ou pour le vendre. Un artefact pareil ou: Or to sell it. An artefact like this would open many doors, far from here.
Et nous, qu’en faisons-nous ?: And what do we do with it?
Rendre l’artefact au sanctuaire de l’Our: Return the artefact to the Bear shrine.
L’Ours retrouvera son artefact: The Bear will have its artefact back
Un objet sacré soustrait à l’Ours: A sacred object taken from the Bear
Nous le confierons au premier sanctuaire: We will entrust it to the first Bear shrine on our road. What belongs to the mountain must return to it.
Il voyagera avec nous. Sa gemme paiera u: It will travel with us. Its gem will pay for a blade, when the day comes.
Vous voulez les galeries pour l’Ours ? D: You want the galleries for the Bear? Come down and get them.
Les galeries sont à nous de nouveau ! Bo: The galleries are ours again! Borin will hear of it before nightfall.
Ce chef n’agissait pas seul. Quelqu’un p: That chief was not acting alone. Someone was paying for these winches and these carts.
Alors vous aussi, vous venez pour le fil: So you’ve come for the vein too. At least the Raven doesn’t hide it.
Le filon est à nous. Plantons notre bann: The vein is ours. Let us plant our banner at the entrance; the Bear will have to deal with us now.
Or it will come and take it back from us.
Le campement du Corbeau, abandonné en hâ: The Raven camp, abandoned in a hurry. The fires are still warm, the tents overturned.
Des ordres, pliés dans un coffre. La mêm: Orders, folded in a chest. The same hand everywhere, the same signature: the Spymaster. Whoever ran the miners took orders from higher up.
Le Maître Espion du Corbeau. Borin voudr: The Raven Spymaster. Borin will want to read these orders, and so will we.
Un sanctuaire de l’Ours. Des offrandes l: A Bear shrine. Offerings left to the mountain: miners’ tools, polished stones, a purse of old coins.
Personne ne viendra les compter avant de: No one will come to count them for months. Offerings feed no one.
Ce sont des prières, Maelor. Pas une cai: These are prayers, Maelor. Not a cashbox.
Que laissons-nous à la montagne ?: What do we leave to the mountain?
Respect the offerings and move on.
La montagne garde ce qu’on lui donne. La: The mountain keeps what is given to it. Let us at least leave it that.
Cinquante pièces. La montagne ne réclame: Fifty coins. The mountain will claim nothing back; its guardians, perhaps.
Borin nous attend demain. Tout ce que no: Borin expects us tomorrow. Everything we have done in these mountains will be laid before him.
Ce qui comptera, ce ne sont pas nos mots: What will count is not our words before him, but what his miners and his mountain will say of us.
Deux Sceaux, bientôt. Plus nous en porto: Two Seals, soon. The more we carry, the more the clans see us as a threat. One day we will have to decide what use they truly are to us.
Le minerai… n’en était qu’une part. Ceux: The ore… was only one part of it. Those we serve need many other things. Your Seals, for instance.
Les Ombres, encore, derrière un autre cl: The Shadows again, behind another clan. The Raven was only one more hand.
Le Sceau est à vous. La montagne l’a vu,: The Seal is yours. The mountain saw it, and so did my warriors. Do not come back here looking for anything else.
Alaric vous a reconnu, dit-on, et le gén: Alaric recognised you, they say, and the Serpent General fell to your blades. The Lion speaks well of you. The Bear will listen, but it will judge for itself.
On m’a rapporté le Sceau du Lion, pris p: Word reached me of the Seal of the Lion, taken by trial. The Lion respects the law of the duel. The Bear, for its part, remembers those who force doors.
Vous portez le Sceau du Lion. Ce que vou: You carry the Seal of the Lion. What you are worth, I will judge here.
Les marchands qui montent des plaines ra: The merchants who come up from the plains say that you brought back the captives of Clearwood. That is why I receive you, instead of having you escorted back to the pass.
Les marchands des plaines racontent auss: The merchants of the plains also say that at Clearwood you carried off the coffers while the captives were leaving. I receive you because the Lion gave you its Seal, not because I believe you.
Les plaines parlent peu de vous. Tant mi: The plains say little of you. All the better: you will begin here with neither debt nor credit.
Le Clan du Corbeau creuse nos mines sacr: The Raven Clan is digging our sacred mines without our consent. It tears from the mountain what it gives only to those who respect it.
Repoussez le Corbeau hors des galeries,: Drive the Raven out of the galleries, and the Seal of the Bear will hear your name. Fail, or help yourselves along the way, and the mountain will remember.
Ces mines ne sont pas qu’un trésor, Anci: These mines are not merely a treasure, Elder Borin. If the Raven digs beyond what the mountain can endure, the balance of these valleys will fall with its galleries. Before we draw the sword, let us learn why it digs so deep.
Ou laissons l’Ours et le Corbeau s’user: Or let the Bear and the Raven wear each other down. Two weakened clans before open mines… I only say what everyone will think on seeing these galleries.
Nous ne sommes pas venus vider la montag: We did not come to empty another clan’s mountain. Clans set against one another: that is how ours fell.
Alors, étrangers. Défendrez-vous les min: So, strangers. Will you defend the Bear’s mines?
Parole claire devant l’Ours: A clear word before the Bear
Accepter, contre une part du minerai rep: Accept, for a share of the recovered ore.
Chaque part réclamée pèsera dans le juge: Every share claimed will weigh in the judgement
Alors montez. Les galeries sont haut dan: Then climb. The galleries are high in the mountain, and the Raven has eyes on every pass.
Vous chiffrez déjà ce que vous n’avez pa: You are already pricing what you have not recovered. Here is an advance, since you want one. The mountain has a long memory: it will remember what you claimed.
Les chariots sont à nous. Ce minerai sen: The carts are ours. This ore smells of cold stone… and something else.
À Bois-Clair, la bourse du clan nous a t: At Clearwood, the clan’s purse kept us standing. I see no reason the mountain should be any different.
Un convoi descend des galeries : des cha: A convoy coming down from the galleries: covered carts, loaded with black stones that don’t shine. Light escort, two guards and a driver.
Du minerai volé à l’Ours. Si nous le pre: Ore stolen from the Bear. If we take it, no one will ever give it back to Borin anyway. It might as well be of use to someone.{0}
Ce minerai ne ressemble à rien de ce que: This ore resembles nothing I have ever seen. Borin must know what the Raven is carrying off, before we decide what it is worth.
Mark the convoy and warn Borin.
Borin saura ce que le Corbeau emporte: Borin will know what the Raven is carrying off
Seize the ore for the clan.
Je les suis jusqu’au pont et je laisse n: I’ll follow them to the bridge and leave our sign on the last milestone. The Bear scouts will know where to look.
Les gardes ne s’enfuient pas. Ils se ser: The guards aren’t running. They’re closing in around the carts, blades drawn.
L’entrée des galeries sacrées. Des tente: The entrance to the sacred galleries. Raven tents, winches, carts. They’re still digging, and their chief is watching the descent.
Les étrangers du col. Vous aviez promis: The strangers from the pass. You promised to look away. So look away, and let us finish.
Encore des étrangers payés par l’Ours ?: More strangers paid by the Bear? This mountain belongs to it no more than to us. The vein goes to whoever can take it.
Ces galeries sont sacrées pour l’Ours, e: These galleries are sacred to the Bear, and this vein does not smell of honest stone. Let us take them back, and return them to Borin.
Ou reprenons-les pour nous. Le Corbeau a: Or take them back for ourselves. The Raven has already done the work; we would only need to change the banner at the entrance.
Chasser le Corbeau et rendre les galerie: Drive out the Raven and return the galleries to the Bear.
Combat contre le chef des mineurs du Cor: Battle with the Raven Mine Chief
Les galeries rendues à l’Ours: The galleries returned to the Bear
Chasser le Corbeau et garder le filon so: Drive out the Raven and keep the dark vein for the clan.
Le filon gardé pour le clan: The vein kept for the clan
Tenir parole au Corbeau et le laisser fi: Keep your word to the Raven and let it finish.
Le Corbeau vous doit une faveur: The Raven owes you a favour
Now there are strangers who can count. The Raven does not forget those who keep their word.
Et l’Ours n’oubliera pas ceux qui l’ont: And the Bear will not forget those who betrayed it.
Et nous n’oublions pas ceux qui nous ont: And we do not forget those who pulled us out of the rockfall.
Comme les survivants de Bois-Clair, ils: Like the survivors of Clearwood, they want to speak in their own words. Let them walk with us, without dictating what they will say.
Les témoins de Bois-Clair se sont tus so: The witnesses of Clearwood fell silent under our blades. I do not want the mountain to count any more.
Des témoins libres pèsent plus lourd qu’: Free witnesses weigh more than any account we could give ourselves.
Ils ont vu ce que nous avons fait des ga: They saw what we did with the galleries. If we let them go down, Borin will hear it from their own mouths.
Ils parlent beaucoup, et ce qu’ils diron: They talk a great deal, and what they say will no longer belong to us once they are down below.
Nous étions dans les galeries quand le C: We were in the galleries when the Raven took them. We saw everything: the charges, the vein, the carts.{0}
We want to tell Borin ourselves.
Que faisons-nous d’eux ?: What do we do with them?
Un acte que la montagne retiendra: A deed the mountain will remember
Merci. Nous marcherons avec vous, mais n: Thank you. We will walk with you, but we will speak for ourselves.
Ils se taisent, maintenant. Nous aussi,: They are silent now. We too will have to live with that silence.
Il porte la même résonance que l’autel d: It carries the same resonance as the altar of the Shadows, on the Lion’s plain.
Le filon. Une veine noire dans la roche,: The vein. A black seam in the rock that doesn’t give back the torchlight. It seems to breathe, if you look at it too long.
Voilà ce que le Corbeau creusait. Ce min: This is what the Raven was digging for. This ore does not belong to the mountain.{0}
Un tel minerai vaut une fortune, ou une: Ore like this is worth a fortune, or a curse. Perhaps both.
Que faisons-nous du filon ?: What do we do with the vein?
Seal a shard of it as proof.
Je le scelle dans un coffre doublé de pl: I am sealing it in a lead-lined chest. Borin must see it, and others after him.
The seam bursts into a thousand dull shards. Whatever it was, we’ll never know now.
Le Corbeau ne cherchait pas l’or. Il che: The Raven was not after gold. It was after this black ore, and it was after it for someone else.
Celui qui commandait le Corbeau fuit ver: The one who commanded the Raven is fleeing to the heights: its Spymaster. Bring him back, or stop him from ever returning, and the Seal of the Bear will seal our alliance.
Les ordres du campement portaient sa sig: The orders from the camp bore his signature. He’s the one who paid for the winches and the carts.
Celui qui tire les fils reste rarement p: The one who pulls the strings rarely stays near the galleries. We will have to go and find him.
Vous avez bien travaillé pour l’Ours. Do: You have worked well for the Bear. A pity you do not know who you are really working for.
Vous réclamez mon Sceau, mais la montagn: You claim my Seal, but the mountain does not entrust it to you. Then win it by its law: my warriors and I, against your company.
Vous voulez mon Sceau par la force ? Alo: You want my Seal by force? Then win it by the law of the mountain: my warriors and I, against your company.

Les galeries respirent de nouveau parce: The galleries breathe again because you returned the sacred galleries to the Bear instead of planting your own banner there. My miners will go back down tomorrow.
You drove out the Raven, it is true. Then you kept the dark vein for your clan, in a mountain that does not belong to you.
Pendant que mes mineurs attendaient, vou: While my miners waited, you let the Raven empty our galleries. You had given your word to thieves, and you kept it better than mine.
Les galeries sacrées n’ont été ni repris: The sacred galleries were neither retaken nor defended. I will not build an alliance on what never happened.
Les mineurs sont venus dire eux-mêmes ce: The miners came to tell what they saw themselves. No one put words in their mouths, and that is why I believe them.
Je sais pourquoi des mineurs se taisent: I know why miners keep silent behind your blades. Do not ask me to call that silence an absence of witnesses.
Aucun mineur n’est venu parler pour vous: No miner came to speak for you. All I have left are the traces left in the rock.
Voici l’éclat du filon sombre que nous a: Here is the shard of the dark vein that we sealed. It resembles no ore of this mountain, Elder. What the Raven was digging served more than the Raven alone.
Votre nom est arrivé ici avant vous, et: Your name reached here before you, and it carries great weight. When you speak, the mountain does not mistrust you.
On parle de vous dans les vallées, et pa: People speak of you in the valleys, and not only ill. I am willing to take you at your word.
Votre nom est arrivé avant vous, et il n: Your name arrived before you, and it does not plead in your favour. Your words will weigh only what your deeds weigh.
Vous revenez des galeries. La montagne a: You return from the galleries. The mountain has already spoken before you: its scree, its miners, its dead fires. I will listen to it once more, then I will listen to you.
Vous ne pouvez plus changer ce que la mo: You can no longer change what the mountain has seen. Tell me only what you ask of the Bear.
Ask for the trial of the Bear.
Il y a aussi ceci, Ancien, et la montagn: There is this as well, Elder, and the mountain bears the trace of it:
Et l’Ours n’oubliera pas ce qui pèse con: And the Bear will not forget what weighs against them:
The Seal of the Bear is in your hands. Borin has sealed the Bear’s alliance, and the Raven Spymaster fell in the galleries he was having emptied.
Le Sceau de l’Ours est entre vos mains,: The Seal of the Bear is in your hands, but you took the Seal of the Bear by trial. Borin’s warriors let you pass; the Bear will not forgive this wrested Seal.
L’éclat du filon sombre voyage avec nous: The shard of the dark vein travels with us, sealed in a chest. One more weight the Seals make us carry. I sometimes wonder which of these burdens is truly leading us anywhere.
Le filon est resté au fond de la montagn: The vein stayed at the bottom of the mountain. What the Raven wanted with it, we will only learn later.
Deux Sceaux. La route du Tournoi des Gra: Two Seals. The road to the Tournament of the Great is taking shape, and every clan we meet will remember how we won them.
